description: This file defines a class NavViewMenuItemTemplateSelector that inherits from DataTemplateSelector, used to select different data templates based on the type of navigation item (NavCategory or NavCategoryGroup) in a UWP application.

classes.name: NavViewMenuItemTemplateSelector
classes.description: A sealed class that inherits from DataTemplateSelector, used to select appropriate templates for navigation items based on their type.

methods.name: SelectTemplateCore
methods.description: Overrides the method to select a DataTemplate based on the type of the item (NavCategory or NavCategoryGroup).

methods.name: SelectTemplateCore
methods.description: Overloaded method that calls the base method, passing the item and container, to select the appropriate DataTemplate.
